description: This is an Android Fragment class named HomeFragment that manages UI components, map display, weather updates, and job data for a driver app.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Android Fragment handling the home screen UI, including map display, weather info, and job count.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes UI components, map, and weather updating schedule.

methods.name: numberOfJobs
methods.description: Reads stored job data and returns the number of pending jobs.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the current date in a formatted string.

methods.name: scheduleUpdateLocation
methods.description: Sets up periodic weather and job updates every minute.

methods.name: getWeather
methods.description: Fetches and displays current weather information from JSON data.

methods.name: focusMap
methods.description: Adjusts the map view to the driver's current location with toggled zoom.

methods.name: onMapReady
methods.description: Initializes map UI settings and positions the camera.
